name: Goethe University Frankfurt
description: Goethe University Frankfurt is a public research university in Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, founded in 1914 by local citizens. It has about 41,000 students across 16 faculties.
whyIncluded: Goethe University Frankfurt is among the 10 universities in Germany most chosen by international students (6,544 international students, 16% of 41,508, in winter semester 2024/25), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: Informatik B.Sc.
programmes.summary: No tuition, including for international students. The figure is only the compulsory semester contribution, which includes a Germany-wide transport ticket and a 50 euro administration fee.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees: Hesse charges no general tuition fees, including for non-EU students, and Goethe's re-registration page lists only the semester contribution. Compulsory fees = Semesterbeitrag for winter semester 2026/27, EUR 408.28 x2: Deutschlandsemesterticket 226.80 + Palmengarten/AStA ticket 1.10 + AStA hardship fund 1.60 + student body 17.10 + social/culture ticket 2.20 + campus bike 2.98 + Studierendenwerk 106.50 + Hesse administration fee (Verwaltungskostenbeitrag) 50.00. History from Goethe's 'Semesterbeitraege 2009-2026' PDF (linked from the same page): winter 2024/25 EUR 337.63 (ticket 176.40, Studierendenwerk 86.50) -> 675.26; winter 2025/26 EUR 381.28 (ticket 208.80, Studierendenwerk 96.50) -> 762.56; summer terms not used. Programme page uni-frankfurt.de/en/studium/studiengaenge/informatik-bachelor. Language not read; Goethe's bachelor's degrees are German-taught (the only English-taught ones are listed separately). Standard period 6 semesters assumed for a Goethe bachelor's (not read from the programme page).
